meta.title: MoneyFlow — Know exactly how much extra you saved this month
meta.description: A personal finance tracker. Savings = Income − Fixed − Variable.

common.tagline: Know exactly how much extra you saved this month

welcome.tagline: Know exactly how much extra you saved this month

formula.title: One formula, everything follows
formula.body: Inspired by Nick Maggiulli's Just Keep Buying. What matters isn't where it went — it's what's left.

different.title: Not another category-tracking app
different.body: You don't have to log every coffee. Spend 30 seconds at month-end entering your total variable expenses — that's it.

extra.title: How much extra you actually saved
extra.body: ETF auto-investment is "pay yourself first" — fixed and non-negotiable. After fixed, variable, and ETF, what's left is Extra Savings — the one number this app cares about.

month.subtitle: Record this month's income and expenses, then return to the dashboard.

income.title: This month's income
income.hint: Salary is fixed. Bonus is a one-off extra for this month.

expense.title: This month's expenses
expense.hint: Enter the variable expense total. Optionally break it down by category.

bonus.title: Bonus
bonus.hint: A one-off extra for this month.

variable.title: Variable expenses
variable.hintWithItems: Total for {month} is the sum of the categories below.
variable.readonlyHint: While categories are expanded, the total tracks their sum.

items.title: Category breakdown
items.hint: Track what you spent on. While open, variable expense total follows the sum.
items.categoryEmpty: Optional — record what you spent on each category.

note.title: Note
note.hint: Optional — a reminder for yourself (up to {max} chars).
note.placeholder: e.g., spent more on travel this month

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Long-term trend of monthly extra savings.

table.noRecords: No records this year. Update variable expenses from the dashboard and they'll show up here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Set up once, then just update variable expenses each month.
settings.onboardBanner: Finish your settings first, then return to the dashboard.

etf.title: ETF (regular investment)
etf.hint: Fixed monthly investment. Subtracted from total savings before extra savings.
etf.label: Monthly investment amount

fixed.title: Fixed expenses
fixed.hint: Recurring monthly costs like rent, subscriptions, mobile.

defaults.title: Default variable-expense template
defaults.hint: Pre-fills these categories every time you open the update form. Adjust amounts as needed.
defaults.empty: No template yet. You can still record manually at month-end.

preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: Assumes no bonus and no variable expenses for the month.
